subject: Bed and mattress support that starts with the routine
preheader: A brief introduction to Sleep Choice and our seven-night in-home trials.
intro: If we have not worked together, I am David from Sleep Choice. We work with occupational therapists on therapeutic beds and mattresses, using seven-night in-home trials to support client-specific equipment decisions.
The starting point is what needs to happen around the bed, not simply which product to order.
body: Settling, repositioning, transfers and assistance overnight can each raise different equipment questions. Looking at that sequence helps frame what you want to explore in a trial.

We can discuss the bed, mattress and accessories together, help organise the trial and stay involved as the setup is assessed. You remain the clinical lead, with the person's goals and home circumstances shaping the discussion.
Equipment is only one part of sleep and daily function. Our role is to help with the equipment questions, not promise that a new bed will resolve a sleep problem.
actionText: Reply with a short, de-identified brief or a question about how a trial works. A practical question is enough to begin the conversation.
trialFooterText: Sleep Choice offers seven-night in-home bed and mattress trials.
